## WQGuard v1.3.1 (Build 18)

新增 2026 最新 iOS 本地提权/隐私绕过漏洞特征库、ARM64 `svc #0x80` 直接系统调用指令级扫描与 13 项固件 CVE 暴露态势雷达正式版。

---

### 中文更新说明

- **新增 ARM64 `svc #0x80` (`0xD4001001`) 直接系统调用指令级扫描 (`INSN_ARM64_SVC_0X80`)**：
  - 在 Mach-O 静态分析引擎新增 4 字节对齐指令扫描，覆盖 `arm64` / `arm64e` / `arm64_32` 全切片、`__TEXT,__text` / `__stubs`、自定义可执行段（`VM_PROT_EXECUTE`）、无节头代码间隙及文件支撑节，直接识别绕过 `libsystem_kernel.dylib` 导入表向内核发起系统调用的隐蔽载荷（精准跳过 FairPlay `encryptedRange` 与非代码元数据段）。
- **新增 `CVE-2026-65339`（`audiomxd` 麦克风静默 TCC 绕过）检测**：
  - 支持无 App Group 声明的独立前置拦截，覆盖 `MediaExperience.framework` 私有框架、`CMSessionSetProperty` / `AudioSessionSetCMProperty` 私有符号、`com.apple.audio.audiomxd` / `com.apple.coremedia.audiomxd` XPC 服务及私有权限；严格隔离 `AudioToolbox` / `AVFAudio` / `AURemoteIO` 等公开音频接口，对合法模拟器与游戏零误报。
- **新增 `BookRestore` / `bl_sbx` 沙盒逃逸与 `MobileGestalt` 系统配置篡改检测**：
  - 拦截引用 `BookLibraryPrivate.framework`、`com.apple.bookassetd` / `com.apple.itunesstored` XPC 服务、`com.apple.itunesstored.private*` 权限、`BLDatabaseManager.sqlite` / `downloads.28.sqlitedb` 越权恢复写目标，以及篡改 `com.apple.MobileGestalt.plist` / `systemgroup.com.apple.mobilegestaltcache` 的侧载包。
- **新增 `CVE-2026-84493`（`AccessorySetupKit` 蓝牙配对 TCC 绕过）主包与 `.appex` 扩展检测**：
  - 检测非 App Store 应用及独立 `PlugIns/*.appex` / `Extensions/*.appex` 扩展声明 `com.apple.private.accessorysetupkit*` 私有权限，或调用 `AccessorySetupKit` / `ASAccessorySession` 却缺失 `NSBluetoothAlwaysUsageDescription` 与 `NSAccessorySetupKitSupports` 的静默蓝牙绕过手法。
- **扩展高危越权 Entitlements 与隐蔽动态加载检测**：
  - 全链路覆盖 `no-sandbox`、`no-container`、`container-required=false`、`com.apple.private.MobileContainerManager.allowed`、`AppDataContainers`、非系统包 `platform-application=true`、私有 `com.apple.private.tcc.allow*` 免弹窗特权及通配符 `keychain-access-groups` (`*` / `.*`) 检测。
  - 新增纯 C 字符串 `dlopen` + `dlsym` 动态解析私有框架/符号检测，以及非常规后缀、包内符号链接与畸形损坏 Mach-O (`CorruptMachO:UnparseableBinary`) 深度审计。
- **2026 固件 CVE 暴露态势雷达扩展至 13 项**：
  - 新增追踪 **`CVE-2026-20700`**（`dyld` 0-day 任意代码执行，CVSS 9.8）、**`CVE-2026-113897`**（WebKit GPU & WebContent 沙盒逃逸，CVSS 8.8）、**`CVE-2026-65339`**（`audiomxd` 麦克风绕过，CVSS 7.5）、**`CVE-2026-84493`**（`AccessorySetupKit` 蓝牙绕过，CVSS 6.5）与 **`PoC:BookRestore`**（`bookassetd` / `MobileGestalt` 越权覆写，CVSS 7.8）。
  - 更新 `0day:worse_query` 补丁边界，支持预发布版本号识别（精准区分仍受暴露的 `iOS 27.3 beta 1` 与已修补的 `iOS 27.3 beta 2+` / `27.3` 正式版）。

---

### English Release Notes

- **ARM64 `svc #0x80` (`0xD4001001`) Direct Syscall Instruction Scanner (`INSN_ARM64_SVC_0X80`)**:
  - Performs 4-byte-aligned instruction-level scanning across all `arm64` / `arm64e` / `arm64_32` slices, `__TEXT,__text` / `__stubs`, custom executable (`VM_PROT_EXECUTE`) segments, unsectioned code gaps, and file-backed sections to catch payloads invoking kernel syscalls directly without `libsystem_kernel.dylib` imports while skipping FairPlay `encryptedRange` and non-code metadata sections.
- **`CVE-2026-65339` (`audiomxd` Silent Microphone TCC Bypass) Detection**:
  - Pre-gate standalone detection covering `MediaExperience.framework` linkage, `CMSessionSetProperty` / `AudioSessionSetCMProperty` symbols, `com.apple.audio.audiomxd` / `com.apple.coremedia.audiomxd` XPC endpoints, and private entitlements — with zero false positives on legitimate `AudioToolbox` / `AVFAudio` / `AURemoteIO` apps and emulators.
- **`BookRestore` / `bl_sbx` Sandbox Escape & `MobileGestalt` Tampering Detection**:
  - Detects `BookLibraryPrivate.framework`, `com.apple.bookassetd` / `com.apple.itunesstored` XPC endpoints, `com.apple.itunesstored.private*` entitlements, `BLDatabaseManager.sqlite` / `downloads.28.sqlitedb` overwrite targets, and `com.apple.MobileGestalt.plist` / `systemgroup.com.apple.mobilegestaltcache` tampering indicators.
- **`CVE-2026-84493` (`AccessorySetupKit` Silent Bluetooth TCC Bypass) App & `.appex` Detection**:
  - Flags non-App Store apps and standalone `PlugIns/*.appex` / `Extensions/*.appex` extensions declaring `com.apple.private.accessorysetupkit*` entitlements or invoking `AccessorySetupKit` / `ASAccessorySession` without required `NSBluetoothAlwaysUsageDescription` and `NSAccessorySetupKitSupports` declarations.
- **Expanded Dangerous Entitlement & Dynamic Symbol Evasion Auditing**:
  - Unified `.ipa` / `.tipa`, `.app`, and registry evaluation for `no-sandbox`, `no-container`, `container-required=false`, `com.apple.private.MobileContainerManager.allowed`, `AppDataContainers`, non-Apple `platform-application=true`, `com.apple.private.tcc.allow*`, and wildcard `keychain-access-groups` (`*` / `.*`), plus C-string `dlopen` + `dlsym` private framework/symbol resolution, magic-based non-standard Mach-O discovery, and `CorruptMachO:UnparseableBinary` detection.
- **13-CVE 2026 Firmware Posture Radar (with Prerelease Beta Precision)**:
  - Adds **`CVE-2026-20700`** (`dyld` 0-day, CVSS 9.8), **`CVE-2026-113897`** (WebKit GPU & WebContent sandbox escape, CVSS 8.8), **`CVE-2026-65339`** (`audiomxd` mic bypass, CVSS 7.5), **`CVE-2026-84493`** (`AccessorySetupKit` Bluetooth bypass, CVSS 6.5), and **`PoC:BookRestore`** (`bookassetd` / `MobileGestalt` overwrite, CVSS 7.8), and distinguishes exposed `iOS 27.3 beta 1` from patched `iOS 27.3 beta 2+` / `27.3` GA for `0day:worse_query`.
